title.zh: 磁盘清理报告入库（repo slim 2026-11-02；含连带误删与恢复步骤）
title.en: Record the repo slim report 2026-11-02 (including the collateral toolchain deletion and recovery steps)

intent.zh: 把 Chief 2026-11-02 执行的磁盘清理 A→B→C 记录入库：清理前后数字（target 428 GiB→0、D free 226.3→641.9 GB +415.6 GB、工作区 371 MB + .git 126 MB）、删除清单（7 个陈旧 worktree 名称与丢弃内容摘要、498 scratch 目录、cargo clean 190.4 GiB、u038 230 MB、render-bvh 副本）、连带误删（target/toolchains/{cuda-12.8.1,mujoco-3.12.0,libmathdx} 与 target/mathdx11）与恢复步骤（scripts/prepare-cuda-probe.ps1 + scripts/prepare-native-probe.ps1，mathdx11 见 g03-mathdx-alignment/README.md；恢复前默认 cuda 构建/原生测试不可用）、QA 锚点（guards 9e000bfc../37,000 B、aggregate 034c7551..、复算时间 2026-11-02T16:13:11+08:00）、声明（冻结仅作历史记录、不得再声称该冻结可执行；worktree 丢弃项不属证据、不影响 attempt5 结论）；manifest 自洽。
intent.en: Record Chief's 2026-11-02 disk cleanup A->B->C: before/after numbers (target 428 GiB -> 0, D free 226.3 -> 641.9 GB (+415.6 GB), working tree 371 MB + .git 126 MB), removal list (7 stale worktrees with discarded-content summary, 498 scratch dirs, cargo clean 190.4 GiB, u038 230 MB, render-bvh copies), collateral deletion (target/toolchains/{cuda-12.8.1,mujoco-3.12.0,libmathdx} and target/mathdx11) with recovery steps (prepare-cuda-probe.ps1 + prepare-native-probe.ps1, mathdx11 per g03-mathdx-alignment/README.md; default cuda build/native tests unavailable until restored), QA anchor (guards 9e000bfc../37,000 B, aggregate 034c7551.., recomputed 2026-11-02T16:13:11+08:00), and the statements (the freeze is a historical record only and must not be claimed executable; the discarded worktree items are not evidence and do not affect the attempt5 conclusion); self-consistent manifest.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/repo-slim-2026-11-02/` 含 README.md 与 manifest.txt（自洽）；内容覆盖清理前后数字、删除清单（7 worktree + 498 scratch + cargo clean 190.4 GiB + u038 230 MB + render-bvh 副本）、连带误删（toolchains/mathdx11）与恢复步骤（两个 prepare 脚本 + mathdx11 README）、恢复前默认 cuda 构建/原生测试不可用、QA 锚点（guards 9e000bfc.. + 复算时间 2026-11-02T16:13:11）、声明（冻结仅作历史记录不可声称可执行；worktree 丢弃项不属证据、不影响 attempt5 结论）。
不改判据数值/清单/参考/fixtures/src/内核身份；不声明越界结论（跨上游一致/精度合规/验收类）；零 GPU、零构建。
note: Arch 2026-11-02 注册（QA 对账 3 观察之 2）。记录 Chief 的瘦身事实与恢复前置；不涉及代码/构建；target 已清空、B 类卡需先 prepare 再 start。
